title: Terminal filesystem listings must never fetch notebook/insight indexes; use include_content_type
answers: Terminal stalls when listing a folder
Why does ls in the terminal paginate all notebooks and SQL insights?
How does the terminal decide .md vs .sql vs .json extension?
body:
Directory listing in the terminal uses only fileSystemList with `include_content_type: true` (posthogFilesystem.ts:directoryEntries). Extensions (.md/.sql/.json) derive from `meta.content_type` on each entry via `extension(entry)`.
Do not reintroduce notebooksList/insightsList index loading in loadDirectory/refresh: it paginates every notebook and SQL insight in the project and stalls listing.
Contents load only on open (notebooksRetrieve/insightsRetrieve). Tests assert `notebooksList`, `insightsList` and `apiMutator` are not called during listing/refresh.
When content_type changes, mountEntries must retire the node under the old extension (.md/.sql/.json) so no stale duplicate remains.
